status.evidence: According to Satmo's terms and conditions, Satmo is the trading brand name for the vehicle telematics systems offered by Fuel Safe UK Limited (Company No. 05957321), which is registered at their Bradford headquarters and has been active since 2006 according to Companies House records.

claims.claim: The company reports that its GPS trackers possess a hardware processing capacity capable of analyzing signals from up to 66 satellites simultaneously and selecting the eight strongest signals to calculate position accuracy, as published on the official Satmo Vehicle Tracking website.

The company reports that its hardware devices feature communication via 4G or 3G cellular networks and are built with an internal memory buffer capable of storing up to 96,000 location data points when network connectivity is lost or unavailable.

Satmo Vehicle Tracking released an in-house developed real-time traffic monitoring functionality for its software that integrates congestion and roadworks updates every 15 minutes to assist fleet users with journey planning and route alternative selection.

The company reports offering the Titan 2 tamperproof 12v/24v fleet dashcam, which features an independent G-sensor and an alarm trigger output designed to connect with third-party hardware and telematics systems.

The company reports providing a plug-and-play OBD vehicle tracking system from £8.95 that connects directly to a vehicle's onboard diagnostic port to collect real-time speed, driving behavior, and vehicle performance insights.
The company reports that its software system offers real-time and historical tracking with the built-in technical capability to track up to 10,000 vehicles simultaneously.
Endorsements from small-to-medium enterprise accounts including UV Power Solutions Limited, Hills Contractors, Federal Security, and a regional division of Swiss Post in London.
The company operates as an unfunded vehicle tracking provider with an estimated small team footprint of approximately 4 employees.
claims.note: The detail that the company is 'unfunded' is unconfirmed by published corporate records or available sources.

claims.claim: A dedicated white-label vehicle tracking program developed by Satmo allows third-party resellers and distributors to sell branded fleet management platforms starting from £3.25 per month, according to Satmo Vehicle Tracking.

The company reports that its software architecture supports simultaneous tracking and monitoring of up to 10,000 vehicles with real-time alerts and historical visibility, as detailed on the Satmo Resource Center.
The company operates from a single physical office located at Suite 11, Newlands House One, Inspire Bradford Business Park in Bradford, United Kingdom.

The company reports a headcount of approximately 2 to 10 employees (with third-party databases specifying approximately 4 employees), and provides customer support during standard business hours of Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM.
claims.corrected: The company reports a headcount of approximately 2 to 10 employees (with third-party databases specifying approximately 4 employees), and provides customer support during standard business hours of Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5 PM (closing at 4 PM on Fridays).
claims.source: Yell Listing for Satmo Vehicle Tracking (https://www.yell.com/biz/satmo-vehicle-tracking-bradford-10892508/) and LinkedIn Company Profile (https://uk.linkedin.com/company/satmo-vehicle-tracking)

status.evidence: According to Companies House records, Protrack Solutions Limited changed its name to The Protrack Group Limited (Company No. 08348251) and is active, with Protrack Group Of Companies Limited designated as its person with significant control since July 2023.

claims.claim: Apple App Store version logs for the company’s Auto App Pro fleet management tool confirm the release of update 9.0.3, which incorporated a manual dashboard refresh feature and reduced stale data latency issues.
claims.source: Apple App Store version logs for Auto App Pro

claims.claim: A case study by F12 Consulting confirms that UK delivery and logistics organisations deploy Protrack Group's consolidated, map-based vehicle tracking and telematics software platform to record and analyse driver behaviour.
claims.source: F12 Consult Protrack Group Case Study

claims.claim: The Protrack Group of Companies Privacy Policy establishes internal data governance by outlining the collection, use, and protection of driver tracking analytics and BioStart biometric fingerprint data under strict data protection compliance with a retention limit of contract duration plus six months.

The Protrack Solutions Limited standard Terms and Conditions detail mutual confidentiality protocols restricting vehicle data access to authorized employees, agents, and subcontractors, while explicitly reserving the right to disclose customer system data to UK regulatory authorities such as the Police.
claims.note: Mutual confidentiality protocols and the explicit reservation of rights to disclose customer system data to the Police are not mentioned in the standard Terms and Conditions document.
claims.source: Protrack Solutions Standard Terms and Conditions

claims.claim: A platform modernization partnership with F12 Consult resolved data and server performance bottlenecks by fine-tuning database queries and optimizing AWS infrastructure, which increased platform reliability by 20% and reduced query response times to seconds, according to a case study by F12 Consult.
claims.source: F12 Consult Protrack Group Case Study

claims.claim: The company's mobile tracking application, Auto App Pro, maintains interoperability with external navigation systems through an updated HERE Maps API integration, according to the official Apple App Store listing.
claims.note: The presence of Auto App Pro on the official Apple App Store listing and its updated HERE Maps API integration are unconfirmed details.

claims.claim: The company participated as the lead for the UKRI-funded "ProDrive - Advancing the Safety and Security of Vehicle Fleets" project (Project Reference 105721), which noted an active tracking system and customer base, as reported by the UKRI Gateway to Research.

The company deployed its vehicle tracking and fleet management technologies at Hartpury University’s working farm environment as a partner within the Digital Innovation Farm Tech Box Park program, as reported by Hartpury University.

According to corporate registry profiles tracked by Endole, Protrack Solutions Limited operates with total assets of £1.22 million and cash in bank totaling £12.72 thousand, though exact annual revenue remains officially unreported.
RocketReach reports that Protrack Solutions Limited operates with an estimated revenue of $6.7 million, serving as a regional participant from its Gloucester base.
Protrack Solutions Limited relocated its single corporate office address in April 2026 to 3 Woolstrop Way, Quedgeley, Gloucester, operating with a registry-filed headcount of 3 employees.
claims.corrected: Protrack Solutions Limited relocated its single corporate office address from 3 Woolstrop Way, Quedgeley, Gloucester on 14 May 2014, operating with a registry-filed headcount of 3 employees.
claims.source: UK Companies House Filing History for PROTRACK SOLUTIONS LIMITED (Company 08348251)

claims.claim: The company reports providing 24/7 customer support with expert guidance, installation, and ongoing assistance to keep customer operations running seamlessly.
